paraphrase: Sit quietly and the mind becomes like a still forest pool: all kinds of wonderful and rare animals come to drink, and you will clearly see the nature of all things.
translation_basis: paraphrase made by the unit author from the Pali where the passage was read locally; otherwise from the author's knowledge of the text
